sinnoh_rowan_intro: Professor Rowan: You there! Are you familiar with Pokémon?
They are creatures of mystery, harboring unknown potential.
In my briefcase are three Pokémon. You may choose one.
Consider it a loan — until you prove yourself worthy.
Professor Rowan: Choose wisely. Turtwig, Chimchar, or Piplup.
sinnoh_rowan_starter: Professor Rowan: Your journey begins now. Do not disappoint me.
You received a Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls!
sinnoh_rowan_congrats: Professor Rowan: Incredible. You are the Sinnoh Champion.
You have fulfilled every expectation I placed in you.
The Pokémon world is vast. Your journey has only begun.
Take this — an updated Pokédex and access to the Battle Zone.
You received the NATIONAL DEX and BATTLE ZONE ACCESS!
sinnoh_looker_intro: Looker: I am Looker, of the International Police.
I am investigating a criminal organization known as Team Galactic.
Their leader, Cyrus, has plans that threaten all of Sinnoh.
Should you learn anything... find me.
sinnoh_looker_galactic_tip: Looker: Team Galactic is operating out of Veilstone City.
Their headquarters is behind the game corner.
Be careful. These people are not ordinary criminals.
sinnoh_cynthia_hm: Cynthia: You look like a capable trainer.
Team Galactic has been cutting down trees and blocking roads.
Take this — it lets your Pokémon learn Cut.
sinnoh_cynthia_celestic: Cynthia: The ruins here tell the story of Sinnoh's origin.
Dialga controls time. Palkia controls space.
And at the top of Mt. Coronet... the Spear Pillar.
That is where Team Galactic intends to awaken them.
sinnoh_celestic_elder: Elder: You carry the Old Charm from Cynthia's grandmother.
Long ago, two beings shaped the world at Spear Pillar.
The lake guardians — Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf — keep them in balance.
If Team Galactic captures the lake trio, that balance shatters.
The elder taught you Surf. You can now use SURF outside of battle!
sinnoh_riley_intro: Riley: I sensed something unusual in this cave.
Team Galactic is using the Iron Island to harvest energy from Pokémon.
Join me. Together we can drive them out.
sinnoh_riley_egg: Riley: You fought bravely in there.
Here — take this egg. The Pokémon inside has chosen you.
sinnoh_galactic_jubilife: Galactic Grunt: Our commander Mars has a message for this city.
The old world must be erased for our new universe to be born!
If you get in our way, we'll erase you too!
sinnoh_cyrus_galactic_hq: Cyrus: You are persistent, I'll grant you that.
This world is incomplete. Emotion, willpower, knowledge — all imperfect.
I will use the power of Dialga and Palkia to destroy this world and rebuild it.
A new universe — one of my design, without spirit.
You cannot stop what has already begun.
sinnoh_cyrus_galactic_hq_won: You are an anomaly this world does not deserve.
Take this. The lake trio holds power you will need.
sinnoh_spear_pillar_event: The air trembles. Space and time warp around Spear Pillar!
Cyrus calls out to the heavens — Dialga and Palkia begin to awaken!
The lake guardians appear, straining to contain the chaos.
Cyrus: No! The spirit energy from the lake trio is disrupting everything!
The portal to another dimension tears open behind Cyrus...
sinnoh_mars_intro: Mars: You again? I'm Commander Mars of Team Galactic.
Cyrus-sama's vision will not be stopped by a child!
sinnoh_mars_won: Mars: How... how can you be so strong?
This isn't over. Cyrus-sama will see this through!
sinnoh_jupiter_intro: Jupiter: Commander Jupiter, at your service — to stop you.
Lake Acuity is ours. The Galactic Plan is unstoppable.
sinnoh_saturn_intro: Your interference at the lakes ends here.
sinnoh_cynthia_victory_road: Cynthia: I knew I'd see you here someday.
Just ahead is the Pokémon League. I'll be watching from inside.
Give the Elite Four everything you have.
sinnoh_barry_rival_intro: {rival_name}: Hey, {player_name}! I've been training so hard!
I'm gonna be the best trainer in Sinnoh — no, the WORLD!
But first I have to beat you. Fine! Let's go!
sinnoh_barry_rival_won: You're seriously the best. I'm gonna catch up, I promise!
sinnoh_barry_rival_lost: I told you I've been training! Now I'm gonna beat the Champion too!
sinnoh_old_charm_deliver: You delivered the Old Charm to the elder at Celestic Town.
The elder smiled warmly. 'Thank you, dear. This belonged to my family.'
As thanks, she shared the ancient knowledge of Surf with your Pokémon.
You received the ability to use SURF!
sinnoh_regigigas_awakening: The statue in the Snowpoint Temple begins to tremble...
Ancient power fills the room as Regigigas stirs from its thousand-year slumber!
sinnoh_dialga_encounter: Time itself seems to slow as a roar shakes Spear Pillar!
The ruler of time — Dialga — has descended!
sinnoh_palkia_encounter: Reality bends and warps across Spear Pillar!
The ruler of space — Palkia — has descended!
sinnoh_giratina_encounter: Deep within Turnback Cave, a rift tears open in the fabric of reality...
The ruler of the Distortion World — Giratina — emerges!
sinnoh_newgame_intro: Snow drifts softly over the rooftops of Twinleaf Town.
Your neighbor {rival_name} bursts through your front door.
{rival_name}: {player_name}! Did you hear? There's a red Gyarados at the lake! Come on!
sinnoh_mom_newstart_1: Mom: Off to Lake Verity with {rival_name} again? Bundle up, it's chilly!
Mom: Take good care of your Pokémon, and they'll take good care of you.
sinnoh_mom_newstart_2: Mom: I watched the Pokémon League on TV this morning. Cynthia is amazing!
Mom: Maybe someday I'll be watching YOU on that screen.
sinnoh_mom_newstart_3: Mom: Every time you win a battle, put a little prize money aside.
Mom: Who knows? Maybe one day it'll buy us a house in a whole new region!
sinnoh_mom_home_1: Mom: {player_name}! Welcome to our snowy little Twinleaf cottage!
Mom: Your Hoenn prize money covered it with plenty left for a fireplace.
Mom: I'm starting to collect houses the way you collect badges!
sinnoh_mom_home_2: Mom: Littleroot, Pallet, New Bark... and now Twinleaf.
Mom: The mail carrier needs a map just to keep track of my addresses!
sinnoh_mom_home_3: Mom: I joined a knitting club. We're making scarves for Snover!
Mom: Don't stay out too late near Lake Verity. The legends say a spirit lives there.
sinnoh_barry_house: {rival_name}'s Mom: Oh, {player_name}! {rival_name} ran off again in a hurry.
{rival_name}'s Mom: That child never walks anywhere. I hope he remembered his shoes!
hisui_laventon: Laventon: Welcome to Hisui, the land that will one day be called Sinnoh!
The Pokemon here look different from the ones you know. Hisuian forms, we call them.
They only live here... for now. Catch every one of them and who knows where they'll turn up!
Be careful of the Noble Pokemon. Calm them and they'll trust you.

intro: Hey {player_name}! Pay me if I win — fine, fine, let's battle!
player_won: Ugh! I just need more training!

requirements.fail_text: Roark is digging in the Oreburgh Mine. Go find him there first!

intro: Rock types are unbreakable!
Rocks are my thing!
I'm Roark, the Oreburgh Gym Leader!
My Rock-type Pokémon are as tough as the earth itself!
player_won: Your math cracked my defense. Take the Coal Badge.
Take this Skull Fossil too. The fossil lab in Oreburgh City can revive it!

intro: Grass Pokémon are gorgeous!
My Pokémon smell like flowers!
I'm Gardenia! Oh, you have an amazing aura around you!
But that won't save you from my Grass-types!
player_won: Wow! You're something else! Take the Forest Badge!
player_lost: The power of nature was too much for you!

requirements.fail_text: Gardenia wants to see the Coal Badge from Oreburgh first!

intro: I got here first! Now pay up if you lose — fine, LET'S GO!

requirements.fail_text: Fantina is at the Contest Hall, admiring performances. She'll return to the gym once you've proven yourself with four badges.

intro: The spirits speak to me...
I see your defeat!
Ohohoho! I am Fantina, ze Gym Leader!
I shall defeat you! Oui, certainement!
player_won: Mon Dieu! You are fantastique! Take ze Relic Badge!
player_lost: Ohohoho! Magnifique! You could not beat me!

intro: {player_name}! I've been waiting! Time to pay — BATTLE ME!
player_won: Impossible! You're always one step ahead!
player_lost: I KNEW I'd catch up eventually!

intro: My fists are my weapons!
True strength comes from within!
I'm Maylene. I may not look it, but I'm the Gym Leader here.
I'll give you everything I have!
player_won: You've proven your strength. Take the Cobble Badge.

requirements.fail_text: Maylene is only accepting challengers with 2 Sinnoh Badges.

intro: I was just at the Team Galactic warehouse! Those guys are creepy!
Anyway — BATTLE!
player_won: You're still better than me! One day though!

intro: Water beats everything!
Splash around with me!
I'm Crasher Wake! The Torrential Masked Master!
Feel the power of the waves!
player_won: You're strong — as strong as a raging current! Fen Badge is yours!
player_lost: The wave has crashed! You're swept away!

requirements.fail_text: Crasher Wake is only accepting challengers with 3 Sinnoh Badges.

intro: Oh! {player_name}! I'm heading to Lake Valor after this — BATTLE FIRST!
player_won: Every time! I'll beat you at the lakes though!
player_lost: Lake Valor, here I come — AND I BEAT YOU!

intro: You again. You've been disrupting our plans at every turn.
No matter. The ruins here won't tell you anything useful.
Still — I'll enjoy defeating you.
player_won: ...Unexpected. You have my respect, if nothing else.
The old woman can keep her ruins. For now.
player_lost: As I predicted. Your interference ends here.

requirements.fail_text: Byron is at Iron Island training. Head there and look for him — and maybe bring a friend named Riley.

intro: Steel bends for no one!
My Steel Pokémon have class!
I'm Byron! The Man with the Steel Body!
My Steel-types are impervious to attack!
player_won: Hmm! You broke through my steel! The Mine Badge is yours!
Take this Armor Fossil too. The fossil lab in Oreburgh City can revive it!
player_lost: Solid as steel! You can't crack my defense!

intro: {player_name}! I've grown SO much stronger! BATTLE ME RIGHT NOW!
player_won: You're unreal. I'm gonna train harder than ever!
player_lost: FINALLY! I'm getting closer to you!

intro: Cold as ice, sharp as a blade!
The cold makes you stronger!
I'm Candice! I can tell you've come a long way!
My Ice Pokémon have been waiting for a trainer like you!
player_won: Wow! You're red-hot! The Icicle Badge is all yours!

requirements.fail_text: Volkner left the Gym. He heard about a trainer defeating Cyrus at the Spear Pillar — he went to find you. Defeat Team Galactic at Spear Pillar first!

intro: Feel the electric sea!
My riffs are electrifying!
I'm Volkner. I've been waiting for a trainer who could excite me.
Let's find out if you're the one.
player_won: Ha! I haven't felt this in years! Take the Beacon Badge!
Head through Route 223 — the Pokémon League awaits!
player_lost: Just as I thought. Nothing to be excited about.

intro: I'm Aaron of the Elite Four!
I've worked hard to build my Bug-type team!
player_won: You're tough! My bugs were no match!

intro: Hohoho! I'm Bertha!
Youngsters like you bring a smile to my face — now defend yourself!
player_lost: The earth has swallowed you up!

intro: I'm Flint! Things are about to heat up!
I'm Lucian. I've read every book in Canalave Library.
Math, psychology, strategy — I've mastered them all.
player_lost: My mind is an unbreakable fortress.

intro: I'm Cynthia, the Pokémon League Champion.
I've been watching you since Eterna City.
Now — show me everything you have.
player_won: Your Pokémon felt the power of your math and trust.
You are the new Sinnoh Champion!
player_lost: You put up a wonderful fight.
Come back when you're ready. I'll be here.

fail_text: The guards at the Pokemon League stop you.
Only Trainers with all 8 Sinnoh Badges may enter!

intro: Team Galactic will not be stopped!
You can't pass!
I'm Commander Saturn. Defeating me is impossible.
You made it this far. Then let me show you the meaninglessness of your world.
player_won: ...Take it. The lake guardians await you.
player_lost: A new universe begins. One without imperfect beings like you.

intro: This facility belongs to Team Galactic!
I'm Mars of Team Galactic! This windworks generates energy for our plans!
player_won: Ugh! How annoying! This isn't over!
player_lost: Hmph! Weaklings can't stop Team Galactic!

intro: Only the elite reach this road!
You'll never make it past me!
player_lost: Victory Road lives up to its name!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A Fateful Encounter
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Follow {rival_name} to Lake Verity and find Professor Rowan's briefcase. Choose your first Pokémon!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Coal Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Roark at the Oreburgh City Gym. He's in the Oreburgh Mine — find him first!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: North to Floaroma
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head north through Route 204 to Floaroma Town. Something is wrong at the Valley Windworks...
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.reward: Clear Team Galactic from the Windworks

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Forest Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Gardenia at the Eterna City Gym — but first, drive Team Galactic out of the Galactic Building!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Cobble Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head southeast to Veilstone City and defeat Maylene at the Fighting-type Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Fen Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Head south to Pastoria City. Defeat Crasher Wake at the Water-type Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Old Charm
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cynthia asked you to deliver an Old Charm to the elder at Celestic Town. Team Galactic is nearby — be ready.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Relic Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Return to Hearthome City. With four badges, Fantina is finally at the Gym!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Mine Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Surf to Canalave City. Help Riley on Iron Island first — Byron is training there.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Lake Guardians
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Galactic is attacking all three lakes simultaneously! Defend Lake Verity, Lake Valor, and Lake Acuity.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Raid Team Galactic HQ
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: You have the Galactic Key! Break into the Team Galactic HQ in Veilstone City and stop Cyrus.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Icicle Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Journey north through Routes 216-217 to Snowpoint City. Defeat Candice at the Ice-type Gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Spear Pillar Showdown
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Climb Mt. Coronet to Spear Pillar. Stop Cyrus before he awakens Dialga and Palkia!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Beacon Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Surf east to Sunyshore City. Volkner has been waiting for a trainer who excites him — after your Spear Pillar victory, you're that trainer.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Conquer the Sinnoh League
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: With 8 badges, surf north from Sunyshore on Route 223. Face the Elite Four and Champion Cynthia!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Galactic at the Windworks
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Commander Mars is using the Valley Windworks near Floaroma to power Team Galactic's machines. Stop her!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Galactic Eterna Building
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Team Galactic has set up an illegal operation in the Galactic Building in Eterna City. Clear them out!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Riley's Request
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: A trainer named Riley on Iron Island needs your help driving out Team Galactic. Partner up and clear the cave!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Lake Legends
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The three lakes hold legendary Pokémon — Uxie at Lake Acuity, Mesprit at Lake Verity, Azelf at Lake Valor.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Ruler of Time
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: At the Spear Pillar, Dialga — the ruler of time — remains. Face the temporal Pokémon!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Regigigas Awakening
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Snowpoint Temple holds a sleeping giant — Regigigas, the Colossal Pokémon. It stirs for the worthy.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Haunted Chateau
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: The Old Chateau in Eterna Forest is filled with ghostly Pokémon — and a mysterious appliance Pokémon hidden within.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Distortion World Rift
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cyrus vanished into a rift at Spear Pillar. Somewhere, deep in the earth, the Distortion World waits. Find Giratina.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Master Poffin Chef
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Cook a Mild Poffin (level 50+) at the Poffin House in Hearthome City. Strong rare berries and perfect stirs are the secret.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Hisui Region
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Now that you have the Coal Badge, a space-time rift in Jubilife City leads to ancient Hisui. Catch every Hisuian form and they'll start appearing all over the world.
